spec.description: Is email working right now, and how much was sent and delivered? Each number opens the dashboard that explains it.

spec.expr: max((ALERTS{component="ehlo", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"} * 2) or ALERTS{component="ehlo", alertstate="firing", severity="warning"} or vector(0))

spec.description: Healthy: no alert is open. Watch: a warning is open; look at Needs attention below within the hour. Act now: a critical alert is open and the on-call operator should act. docs/alerts.md explains each alert.
spec.subtitle: From the open alerts
spec.title: Email health

spec.description: Emails handed to the providers in the selected time range. Retries of the same email are not counted again.
spec.subtitle: First tries, time range
spec.title: Sent

spec.description: Emails the providers accepted in the selected time range, including retries that succeeded. Accepted does not tell inbox from spam folder.
spec.subtitle: Accepted, time range
spec.title: Delivered

spec.description: Emails returned as undeliverable in the selected time range: unknown addresses, temporary problems that lasted too long, and refusals of the sender.
spec.subtitle: Returned, time range
spec.title: Bounced

spec.description: Delivered as a share of sent in the selected time range. Healthy: 99% or more. Watch: 97% to 99%. Act: under 97%.
spec.subtitle: Delivered of sent
spec.title: Delivery rate

spec.description: Emails sent, delivered and bounced per minute. A gap between sent and delivered is mail being retried later, bounced or refused.
spec.subtitle: Sent, delivered and bounced, per minute
spec.title: Emails per minute

spec.description: Share of emails each provider accepted in the selected time range. Healthy: 99% or more. Watch: 97% to 99%. Act: under 97%.
spec.subtitle: Accepted share in the time range
spec.title: Delivery rate by provider

spec.description: Emails sent to each provider in the selected time range, first tries only.
spec.subtitle: First tries in the time range
spec.title: Emails sent by provider

spec.description: Share of emails the providers accepted in the last 10 minutes. Healthy: 99% or more. Watch: 97% to 99%. Act: under 97%. An email a provider asked to retry later counts as not delivered until the retry succeeds.
spec.subtitle: Accepted, last 10 minutes
spec.title: Delivered now

spec.description: Recipients who marked an email as spam, per 10,000 delivered, over the last 24 hours. Gmail asks senders to stay under 10 and never reach 30. Complaints arrive hours after delivery, hence the 24-hour window.
spec.subtitle: Per 10,000 delivered, 24h
spec.title: Complaints

spec.description: 95 of every 100 emails were accepted within this time after entering the queue, over the last 10 minutes. Healthy: under a minute. Retries make it longer.
spec.subtitle: 95 of 100 emails, 10 min
spec.title: Time to deliver

spec.description: Share of attempts in the last 10 minutes where the server could not open a conversation with the provider. Under 5% is normal. Above 50% the provider or the network is unreachable.
spec.subtitle: Of attempts, last 10 min
spec.title: Connect errors

spec.description: Emails a provider asked to send again later (the deferred queue), summed over all servers. A few thousand is normal at volume. A number that keeps growing means a provider is refusing mail.
spec.subtitle: Deferred, all servers
spec.title: Awaiting retry

spec.description: Server and provider pairs that ehlo stopped for now: the provider asked to slow down, blocked the server, or complaints were too high. Their mail goes through other servers until they resume.
spec.subtitle: Server and provider pairs
spec.title: Paused senders

spec.description: Emails sent in the last 10 minutes without a DKIM signature, the check providers use to confirm an email really comes from your domain. Should be 0.
spec.subtitle: No DKIM, last 10 min
spec.title: Unsigned mail

spec.description: Alerts open now. critical: act now. warning: act within the hour. info: for awareness. docs/alerts.md explains each one and what to do. The table hides while no alert is open.
spec.subtitle: Firing now; docs/alerts.md explains each
spec.title: Open alerts
